comparison.objective: Feed flexible filament into a tight printer inlet; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual flexible-filament straightening and insertion versus rigid narrow-tool alignment, hammering, and loose-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Filament ≥2 cm deep without kink or spool loss versus four fractures with insert retention and tang containment.
comparison.reason: Tight alignment is shared, but flexible feeding and controlled fracture test different abilities.
